questions.q: To whom does the elder write 2 John?
options: The chosen lady and her children
questions.evidence: The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth

questions.q: Which command, had from the beginning, does the elder repeat?
questions.evidence: Now I beg you, dear lady, not as though I wrote to you a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another

questions.q: Rather than with paper and ink, how does the elder hope to speak?
questions.evidence: Having many things to write to you, I don’t want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you, and to speak face to face, that our joy may be made full
